essence: All awakened beings always grant fruit to mantra practitioners.
The time of awakening is to be known as the period following the time of sleep.
When the two winds are situated in both, the state becomes of a dual nature.
If recited thus while desired and in an awakened state, the mantra grants quick accomplishment.
The hero seat is declared as part of the sequential pentad of seats.
